'''FK Javor Ivanjica''' ({{Lang-sr-Cyrl|ФК Јавор Ивањица}}), known as '''Javor Matis''' for sponsorship reasons, is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Ivanjica]], [[Serbia]]. They compete in the [[Serbian First League]], the second tier of Serbian football."}}
